name: SBI General Arogya Plus Policy

room_rent.note: The wording lists room rent as covered but states no limit; the limit and any co-payment are set in the policy schedule, which is not part of this document.

waiting_initial.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident

waiting_ped.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy

specific_waits.quote: Any types of gastric or duodenal ulcers;
specific_waits.label: Gastric or duodenal ulcers

specific_waits.quote: Surgery on all internal or external tumour/cysts/ nodules/polyps of any kind including breast lumps;
specific_waits.label: Internal or external tumour/cysts/nodules/polyps/breast lumps

specific_waits.quote: All types of Hernia and Hydrocele;
specific_waits.label: Hernia and Hydrocele

specific_waits.quote: Hysterectomy/ myomectomy for menorrhagia or fibromyoma or prolapse of uterus;
specific_waits.label: Hysterectomy/ myomectomy

specific_waits.quote: Non infective Arthritis, Treatment of Spondylosis / Spondylitis, Gout & Rheumatism;
specific_waits.label: Arthritis, Spondylosis, Spondylitis, Gout & Rheumatism

specific_waits.quote: Sinusitis, nasal disorders and related disorders;
specific_waits.label: Sinusitis and nasal disorders

specific_waits.quote: Surgery for prolapsed intervertebral disc unless arising from accident;
specific_waits.label: Surgery for prolapsed intervertebral disc

specific_waits.quote: Vertebro-spinal disorders (including disc) and knee conditions;
specific_waits.label: Vertebro-spinal disorders and knee conditions

specific_waits.quote: Surgery of varicose veins and varicose ulcers;
specific_waits.label: Surgery of varicose veins and varicose ulcers

specific_waits.quote: Medical Expenses incurred in connection with joint replacement surgery due to Degenerative condition, Age related osteoarthritis and Osteoporosis unless such Joint replacement surgery unless necessitated by Accidental Bodily Injury.
specific_waits.label: Joint replacement surgery

specific_waits.quote: Hypertension, Heart Disease and related complications;
specific_waits.label: Hypertension, Heart Disease

sublimits.quote: The following disorders / conditions shall be covered only up to Rs. 50,000/-. This sub-limit shall apply for all the following disorders / conditions on cumulative basis.
sublimits.label: Mental Illness Specified Disorders

sublimits.quote: Genetic Disorders or Diseases are covered up to the Limit `50,000
sublimits.label: Genetic Disorders or Diseases

sublimits.quote: Internal Congenital Diseases are Covered upto the Limit `10% of Sum Insured.
sublimits.label: Internal Congenital Diseases

sublimits.quote: The following procedures will be covered (wherever medically indicated) either as in patient or as part of day care treatment in a hospital up to 50% of -of Sum Insured, specified in the policy schedule
sublimits.label: Modern Treatment Procedures

exclusions.quote: Treatment taken outside India.
exclusions.text: Treatment taken outside India.

exclusions.quote: War, invasion, acts of foreign enemies, hostilities (whether war be declared or not), civil war, commotion, unrest, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power
exclusions.text: War, invasion, acts of foreign enemies, hostilities, civil war, rebellion, revolution, military or usurped power.

exclusions.quote: Injury or disease directly or indirectly caused by or contributed to by nuclear weapons/materials.
exclusions.text: Injury or disease directly or indirectly caused by nuclear weapons/materials.

exclusions.quote: Circumcision unless necessary for treatment of a disease, illness or injury not excluded hereunder, or, as may be necessitated due to an accident
exclusions.text: Circumcision unless medically necessary or due to an accident.

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to the treatment for correction of eye sight due to refractive error less than 7.5 dioptres.
exclusions.text: Refractive error correction for less than 7.5 dioptres.

exclusions.quote: Expenses for cosmetic or plastic surgery or any treatment to change appearance unless for reconstruction following an Accident, Burn(s) or Cancer
exclusions.text: Cosmetic or plastic surgery unless for reconstruction following accident, burns, or cancer.

exclusions.quote: Cost of spectacles, contact lenses, hearing aids, crutches, wheelchairs, artificial limbs, dentures, artificial teeth and all other external appliances , prosthesis and/or devices.
exclusions.text: External appliances, spectacles, contact lenses, hearing aids, crutches, wheelchairs, artificial teeth.

exclusions.quote: Dental treatment or surgery of any kind unless required as a result of accidental bodily injury to natural teeth requiring hospitalization treatment.
exclusions.text: Dental treatment or surgery unless required due to accidental bodily injury requiring hospitalization.

exclusions.quote: Convalescence, general debility, “run-down” condition, rest cure, external congenital anomaly.
exclusions.text: Convalescence, general debility, run-down condition, rest cure, external congenital anomaly.

exclusions.quote: Intentional self-injury (including but not limited to the use or misuse of any intoxicating drugs or alcohol)
exclusions.text: Intentional self-injury or drug/alcohol misuse.

exclusions.quote: Expenses for treatment directly arising from or consequent upon any Insured Person committing or attempting to commit a breach of law with criminal intent
exclusions.text: Treatment arising from committing or attempting to commit a breach of law with criminal intent.

exclusions.quote: Treatment for, Alcoholism, drug or substance abuse or any addictive condition and consequences thereof.
exclusions.text: Treatment for alcoholism, drug, or substance abuse.

exclusions.quote: Venereal disease or any sexually transmitted disease or sickness (excluding HIV / AIDS as mentioned under scope of cover )
exclusions.text: Venereal disease or sexually transmitted diseases (excluding HIV/AIDS).

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to sterility and infertility this includes: i. Any type of sterilization ii. Assisted Reproduction services... iii. Gestational Surrogacy iv. Reversal of sterilization
exclusions.text: Sterility, infertility, assisted reproduction services, surrogacy, sterilization reversal.

exclusions.quote: Dietary supplements and substances that can be purchased without prescription, including but not limited to Vitamins, minerals and organic substances
exclusions.text: Dietary supplements and OTC vitamins/minerals unless prescribed during hospitalization/day care.

exclusions.quote: Surgery to correct deviated septum and hypertrophied turbinate unless necessitated by an accidental body injury.
exclusions.text: Surgery to correct deviated septum and hypertrophied turbinate unless due to accidental injury.

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any treatment, including surgical management, to change characteristics of the body to those of the opposite sex.
exclusions.text: Gender change treatments except as required under Transgender Persons Act 2019.

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any treatment necessitated due to participation as a professional in hazardous or adventure sports
exclusions.text: Treatment due to professional participation in hazardous or adventure sports.

exclusions.quote: Treatments received in heath hydros, nature cure clinics, spas or similar establishments
exclusions.text: Treatments received in health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas or similar establishments.

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any admission primarily for enforced bed rest and not for receiving treatment.
exclusions.text: Rest cure, rehabilitation and custodial care.

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation purposes only are excluded.
exclusions.text: Admission primarily for diagnostic and evaluation purposes.

exclusions.quote: Hospitalization for donation of any body organs by an Insured including complications arising from the donation of organs.
exclusions.text: Hospitalization for organ donation by the insured and associated complications.

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to the surgical treatment of obesity that does not fulfil all the below conditions
exclusions.text: Obesity/weight control surgical treatment not meeting specified clinical criteria.

exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any unproven treatment, services and supplies for or in connection with any treatment.
exclusions.text: Unproven or experimental treatments.

exclusions.quote: Disease / illness or injury whilst performing duties as a serving member of a military or police force.
exclusions.text: Illness or injury sustained while performing duties as a military or police force member.
